title: Shopper Earnings Terms — Shown-Pay Make-Good Credit on Cartwise Shopper Batches
content:
**Condition.** When a shown-pay adjustment is approved on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the shown-pay make-good credit is added after the claimed amount has been multiplied by any share applying to it. The credit is:

(a) **1.50** for a shopper account at the Gold level or above (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date;

(b) **0.75** for an account at the Silver level or above (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date;

(c) **nothing** for every other account.

The account's level and first activation date are read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record; the months are whole calendar months up to the handling date.

## Combinations

| Level | Whole months since first activation | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 36 or more | 1.50 |
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 12 to 35 | 0.75 |
| Silver | 12 to 35 | 0.75 |
| Silver | 36 or more | Nothing |
| Any | Fewer than 12 | Nothing |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | Any | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Gold account, 36 whole months: 1.50; the same account at 35 whole months: 0.75.
- Silver account, 36 whole months: nothing.
